summary: Minimal, correct fix that converts a confusing UnboundLocalError into NotImplementedError, which evalf's upstream handler already catches to leave the expression unevaluated—matching the working arg-order case. Uses the project's established sentinel for unsupported evalf cases.

issues.description: Only the `re` branch gets the `else: raise NotImplementedError` guard; the parallel `im` branch (im.is_number / elif chain) has the same latent UnboundLocalError pattern and could hit the same KeyError-derived path for some inputs. Not exercised by the reported case, so non-blocking, but a fully symmetric fix would guard both.
The bare `raise NotImplementedError` has no message/comment explaining that it signals 'cannot evalf this arg, leave unevaluated' to the upstream handler; a one-line comment would aid future readers.
